# Real credential file commands and real scoped control-plane requests.
skygo auth init --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token-output admin.token
! stdout 'sky(go)?_[0-9a-f]{32}_'
! stderr .
skygo auth principal add alice --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth principal add bob --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth principal add viewer --role reader --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output alice.token --expires-in 24h
skygo auth token issue bob --auth-file $AUTH --output bob.token --expires-in 24h
skygo auth token issue viewer --auth-file $AUTH --output viewer.token --expires-in 24h
skygo --json auth token list --auth-file $AUTH
stdout '"principal": *"alice"'
! stdout '(digest|secret|sky(go)?_[0-9a-f]{32}_)'
server start
taskfile success.json success
taskfile hold.json hold

# The same request ID belongs independently to two principals. Rotation for
# one principal keeps that principal's existing accepted identity.
skygo --token-file alice.token --json run -f success.json --request-id shared --wait
job-id ALICE
skygo --token-file bob.token --json run -f hold.json --request-id shared
job-id BOB
await-file ready
skygo --token-file alice.token --json run -f success.json --request-id alice-second --wait
job-id ALICE_SECOND
skygo --token-file alice.token jobs logs $ALICE
stdout '^done\n$'
skygo --token-file admin.token jobs logs $BOB
stdout '^holding\n$'

# Foreign objects and missing objects produce exactly the same diagnostics.
! skygo --token-file alice.token jobs get $BOB
stderr '^not_found: '
cp stderr missing.err
! skygo --token-file alice.token jobs get 00000000000000000000000000000000
cmp stderr missing.err
! skygo --token-file alice.token jobs logs $BOB
cmp stderr missing.err
! skygo --token-file alice.token jobs cancel $BOB --yes
cmp stderr missing.err
skygo --token-file alice.token --json jobs list
stdout '"id": *"'$ALICE'"'
! stdout '"id": *"'$BOB'"'
skygo --token-file viewer.token --json jobs list
! stdout '"id"'
skygo --token-file viewer.token targets list
stdout 'local'
skygo --token-file viewer.token plan -f success.json
stdout '^local\n$'
! skygo --token-file viewer.token run -f success.json --request-id forbidden
stderr 'permission_denied: '
! skygo --token-file viewer.token jobs cancel $ALICE --yes
stderr '^permission_denied: '

# Own pagination cannot reveal another principal's acceptance high-water.
skygo --token-file alice.token --json jobs list --page-size 1
page-token ALICE_PAGE
cp stdout own-page.json
skygo --token-file bob.token --json run -f success.json --request-id bob-second --wait
skygo --token-file alice.token --json jobs list --page-size 1
cmp stdout own-page.json
! skygo --token-file bob.token jobs list --page-token $ALICE_PAGE
stderr '^invalid_argument: '
skygo --token-file admin.token --json jobs list --page-size 1
page-token ADMIN_PAGE
! skygo --token-file alice.token jobs list --page-token $ADMIN_PAGE
stderr '^invalid_argument: '

skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output alice-new.token --expires-in 24h
await-auth allowed alice-new.token jobs get $ALICE
skygo --token-file alice-new.token --json run -f success.json --request-id shared --wait
stdout '"id": *"'$ALICE'"'
token-id alice.token OLD_ALICE
skygo auth token revoke $OLD_ALICE --auth-file $AUTH
await-auth unauthenticated alice.token jobs get $ALICE
skygo --token-file alice-new.token jobs get $ALICE
! stderr .

# Administrative visibility does not create work under another principal.
skygo --token-file admin.token --json run -f success.json --request-id shared --wait
job-id ADMIN
skygo --token-file admin.token --json jobs list
stdout '"id": *"'$BOB'"'
stdout '"id": *"'$ADMIN'"'
skygo --token-file alice-new.token --json jobs list
! stdout '"id": *"'$ADMIN'"'
skygo --token-file admin.token jobs cancel $BOB --yes
! stderr .
server stop
! stderr .
